prompts.prompt:
Create a polished character concept approval sheet for a new Japanese educational YouTube series about AI history, introducing an ORIGINAL adult male and adult female duo. One landscape 3:2 image, white/off-white studio background, crisp high-resolution full-color 2D Japanese anime illustration, sophisticated graphic JRPG character-design energy inspired by the stylish angular lines and confident color blocking of Atlus's Persona series. Design wholly new identities, clothing and silhouettes, not any existing game character. Both people clearly adult around age 28-30, intelligent and approachable, not schoolchildren.
COMPOSITION: male on left, female on right; each visible head to shoes, large and equally prominent, matching head scale and eye level. Along the top outer corners include ONE clearly separated close-up face portrait of the corresponding character for face review; do not repeat extra bodies. Plenty of white separation. No written words, labels, logos, numbers, watermark or franchise motifs.
MALE: Japanese adult man age 28, lean average athletic build, short tousled charcoal-black hair with a slight asymmetric fringe and small teal highlight on the inner side, expressive dark grey eyes, distinctive mature angular face and friendly curious half-smile, no glasses. Original fitted charcoal short blazer with one thin muted-teal piping detail, warm ivory mock-neck shirt, straight dark charcoal trousers, simple clean black/white sneakers, small understated silver wristwatch. Easy upright stance, one hand loosely open as if asking an interesting question, other relaxed. Not heroic, seductive, muscular or exaggerated.
FEMALE: Japanese adult woman age 30, elegant mature proportions with a naturally narrower waist and softer face than the man, dark auburn chin-length angular bob tucked behind one ear, hazel-brown eyes, attentive warm smile, confident and thoughtful. Original vermilion/coral cropped business jacket over a tucked-in ivory blouse with small dark collar detail, high-waisted straight charcoal trousers, simple dark ankle boots, tiny gold geometric ear studs. One hand resting near her waist and the other gently presenting forward, a subtle natural stance. Business-casual intelligence, no sexualized styling.
Style and production constraints: strong clean ink silhouettes, tasteful two-tone cel shading, precise expressive eyebrows and eyes, editorial fashion proportions, soft neutral fill light with restrained graphic shadow, controllable details that can stay consistent during image-to-video motion. The two must feel like colleagues hosting a smart accessible explainer. Clear natural hands with five fingers, clean outlines, balanced clothing detail. Keep the full-body and face-inset appearances exactly consistent.

Edit the supplied original AI-explainer duo character approval sheet. The user likes the faces and the overall style, and asks ONLY to make the clothing look like scientists. Preserve the exact male and female identities, mature adult ages, faces, eye shapes, hairstyles, hair colors, body proportions, poses, hand positions, shoe styles, white background, clean angular JRPG/anime ink style, cel shading, layout, four depictions (male full body, female full body, and one matching face close-up of each). Keep all four depictions exactly consistent. Do not introduce any existing game character.
Change the clothing on BOTH people into stylish, believable AI-research-scientist clothing:
MALE: replace the charcoal blazer with a clean open white knee-length laboratory coat, restrained realistic seams and pockets and narrow lapels, sleeve cuffs close to wrist. Underneath wear a muted deep-teal mock-neck knit shirt, retaining the dark tailored trousers, sneakers and silver wristwatch. One small pen in the coat breast pocket, no lettering.
FEMALE: replace the vermilion jacket with a clean open white laboratory coat reaching just above the knees, slightly shaped at the waist and with natural fabric drape. Underneath a vermilion/coral blouse with a small dark collar accent, retaining her high-waisted dark trousers, dark ankle boots and tiny geometric gold earrings. One small pen in a breast pocket, no lettering.
The coats should read clearly as scientist/researcher lab coats, not doctors in a hospital: no stethoscope, face mask, surgical scrubs, medical logos or test tubes. This is an approachable intelligent pair of adult AI researchers. Keep the male teal accent and female vermilion accent so they are distinct even in a small video picture-in-picture. No glasses or new accessories over their faces. Keep the same excellent natural hands, faces, original poses and full-body framing. Absolutely no written text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark or background scenery.
